name: abis-drift-monitor
description: Real-time behavioral drift detection for 11 LLMs. 37 tools across 3 tiers (Free/Pro/Admin): live drift scores, 9-score scorecards, silent version change detection, autonomous correction, immune threat assessment, and EU AI Act compliance reporting. Backed by Patent GB2521226.7.
author: CIJ Labs
getting_started: Once installed, ask: 'What is the current drift score for GPT-4o?' or 'Run ABIS daily check'. No API key required for the Free tier (15 tools). Upgrade to Pro (27 tools) or Admin (37 tools) at abis.cijlabs.com/pricing.
